---
title: "Multi-trait models"
format: html
---

The public `mtblr_bed()` route samples corrected Cheng MT-BayesC-Pi or the
factorized pattern-by-scale MT-BayesR extension per logical chain. Both use all binary trait-activity
patterns, including one unique null state, with stable deterministic ordering.
Input is a complete $N\times T$ phenotype matrix and one common-sample packed
BED genotype resource.

The residual covariance may be fixed full SPD or sampled from its declared
inverse-Wishart prior. The marker covariance $V_b$ and Dirichlet
activity-pattern probabilities are sampled authoritatively. Feasible trait
count depends on complete-pattern and memory limits.

Corrected independent-summary Cheng MT-BayesC-Pi and pattern-by-scale
MT-BayesR are public through
`mtblr_csr()` and `mtblr_block_eigen()`. Providers must declare independence
and fixed positive residual scales; predictions and full $V_e$ fields are
unavailable. MT-BayesRC, annotation-informed MTBLR, and overlap-aware
summary likelihoods remain theoretical or planned rather than executable
package capabilities.

Full covariance summaries are distinct from the five iteration × trait
variance traces. Multichain seeds and results are deterministic and independent
of worker assignment.

The [MT BayesR/SBayesR](../methods/mt_bayesr_sbayesr.qmd) page distinguishes
the supported factorized pattern-by-scale target from an unrestricted joint
weight construction. The
[MT BayesRC/SBayesRC](../methods/mt_bayesrc_sbayesrc.qmd) pages retain their
theoretical state-space and annotation-factorization definitions for future
implementation work.
